change: Append one greedy residual-column helper and override only _lr_factor; exact S32 prefix. Original factor arithmetic unchanged except column-selection assignment.

algorithm.selection: first original-index argmax among unselected nonnegative residual scores
algorithm.basis: FP64 two-pass block modified Gram-Schmidt on each selected ORIGINAL A64 column
algorithm.projection: ordinary paid FP32 q.T @ A32; cast resulting vector to FP64 before squared score downdate
algorithm.score_update: residual = maximum(residual - projection^2,0); reapply selected-column exclusion AFTER clamping
algorithm.final_order: ascending selected indices, then unchanged FP32 gathered-column QR and ThinD3 Q1/B
algorithm.breakdown: u64=2^-53; gamma_m=m*u64/(1-m*u64); if max(cn)==0 or selected twice-reorthogonalized residual squared norm <= gamma_m^2*max(cn), stop greedy and fill remaining slots by original stable descending energy order excluding already chosen indices. No denominator clamp or ridge.
algorithm.precision_caveat: This is a QRCP-inspired mixed-precision selection heuristic, not LAPACK QRCP or an exact residual-energy calculation. The chosen-column breakdown tolerance is a fixed machine-resolution convention, not a numerical rank certificate or a bound on score error.

diagnostics: _SRP_STATS cumulative scalar counters: calls,updates,fallbacks,zero_inputs,negative_scores; no arrays retained.
